title: On the Credibility of Evaluating LLMs using Survey Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses to the World Value Survey (WVS) against human population data from culturally distinct countries (USA, UK, Czechia, Germany, Iran, China) using metrics like Mean Squared Difference, KL Divergence, and a novel self-correlation distance.

Administering the World Value Survey prompts in three different languages (English, German, and Czech) to analyze how prompt language impacts the model's cultural alignment with human populations from matching vs. non-matching countries.
